name: s5_regularization
_purpose: Cheap, cache-compatible regularization test (feature noise on cached vision features + question word-dropout), targeting the same overfitting problem as dropout/weight-decay but via a different mechanism. Base config matches the current best primary (dropout=0.2, wd=0.01, K=16, batch=128, lr=3e-3). Feature std measured at ~1.47 over a 200-image sample, so noise-std 0.15/0.4 are roughly 10%/27% of feature std -- mild vs. fairly aggressive.
